title: Michael, Row Your Boat Ashore
transcription:
Michael Row Your Boat Ashore

Michael row your boat ashore,
Hallelujah.
Michael row your boat ashore,
Hallelujah.

Sister help to set the sails,
Hallelujah.
Sister help to set the sails,
Hallelujah.

River Jordan is deep and wide,
Hallelujah.
River Jordan is deep and wide,
Hallelujah.

River Jordan is chilly and cold,
Hallelujah.
River Jordan is chilly and cold,
Hallelujah.

Michael's boat is the gospel boat,
Hallelujah.
Michael's boat is the gospel boat,
Hallelujah.

(End with repeat of the first verse)
